decisions.statement: The reminders are read from the index rather than by walking a folder.
The persona a reminder is sent to and from reads back as the slug alone.
Systemd answers when a schedule next falls due.
A schedule naming no time still to come is answered as never.
When a reminder next falls due is kept beside the page rather than in the commit.
A reminder taken away loses the values kept beside the page too.
The page taken away is named before the values beside it are taken, which can throw.
A reminder is taken away by a program rather than by an agent.
The change taking a file away takes the reminder away rather than an edit composed here.

definition: the reminders there are, when each next falls due, and taking a spent one away
